(every book simultaneously open:1.3),

are in a language that almost makes sense,
the architecture itself slightly wrong —
staircases going sideways, shelves curving inward,

it appears to be moving backward,
(the whole space existing at the frequency just below panic:1.3)

(gravity is a suggestion in this room:1.4),
some books falling up, some suspended perfectly still,
ink lifting off certain pages as floating calligraphy,
(the calligraphy forming shapes that are almost faces:1.3),
a globe somewhere spinning the wrong direction,
a grandfather clock in the background
with all its hands removed — still ticking,
a chandelier made of tangled cassette tape
somehow providing warm light,
a chessboard on a floating table mid-game,
all pieces the same colour

(tall, dangerous proportions, narrow everywhere and generous elsewhere:1.3),
dark copper skin, natural and luminous,
sharp angular features — cheekbones that could cut glass,
large dark eyes with the expression of someone
who has read every book in this room
and found them all slightly disappointing,
(wild natural hair defying gravity in every direction:1.3),
shot through with streaks of deep gold,
not styled — evolved,
her hair its own weather system
